title: A General Framework for E-process Stopping Rules in Best-Arm Identification
abstract: arXiv:2611.31898v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose an e-process stopping rule in the best-arm identification problem. The e-process stopping rule is different from the Chernoff stopping rule by its hypothesis structure on the stopping decision. The major benefit of an e-process stopping rule is the flexibility in stopping rule design and in fact, it recovers previously suggested Chernoff stopping rule on several bandit problems. Moreover, we analyze the asymptotic optimality of the $\delta$-PAC algorithm with the decomposition of e-processes. The decomposition separates optimality conditions into three parts; the sampling policy allocation convergence, the efficiency of e-process design, and the bandit problem's inherent stochastic behavior. Subsequently, we prove a sufficient condition for asymptotic optimality in bandit algorithms. For the application of an e-process stopping rule, we derived an asymptotically optimal algorithm for the generalized linear bandit problem.

translated_title: 最优臂识别中e-过程停止规则的通用框架
translated_abstract: 我们在最优臂识别问题中提出了一种e-过程停止规则。e-过程停止规则与Chernoff停止规则的不同之处在于其对停止决策的假设结构。e-过程停止规则的主要优势在于停止规则设计的灵活性，事实上，它在多个老虎机问题上可以恢复先前提出的Chernoff停止规则。此外，我们通过e-过程的分解分析了δ-PAC算法的渐近最优性。该分解将最优性条件分离为三个部分：采样策略分配的收敛性、e-过程设计的效率以及老虎机问题的内在随机行为。随后，我们证明了老虎机算法渐近最优性的一个充分条件。作为e-过程停止规则的应用，我们推导了针对广义线性老虎机问题的渐近最优算法。
tldr: 该论文提出了最优臂识别中e-过程停止规则的通用框架，通过e-过程分解将最优性条件分为三个部分并证明了渐近最优性的充分条件，进而推导出广义线性老虎机问题的渐近最优算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general e-process stopping rule framework for best-arm identification, proves a sufficient condition for asymptotic optimality by decomposing e-processes into three parts, and derives an asymptotically optimal algorithm for the generalized linear bandit problem.
